subject.title: fix(reef): add timeout and bounded JSON reads to relay transport

question: Should the fixed 15-second response-header deadline apply to every Reef relay request, or only to inbox pull operations that participate in reconnect handling?
rationale: The shared helper placement is clean and proven, but it intentionally changes formerly unbounded auth, friend, send, and acknowledgement calls as well as pulls; repository automation cannot decide the acceptable slow-relay compatibility tradeoff.

options.title: Keep the shared deadline
options.body: Accept one consistent 15-second header deadline for all Reef relay requests so every network operation is bounded.

options.title: Limit the deadline to pulls
options.body: Apply the timeout only to inbox polling so other relay operations preserve their prior unbounded behavior.

recommendation.title: Keep the shared deadline
recommendation.body: Accept one consistent 15-second header deadline for all Reef relay requests so every network operation is bounded.

likelyOwner.reason: They most recently changed and validated this exact request method on current main.
